description.value:
You transmit recordings. Weddings, arguments, radio dramas, a woman reading a shopping list in 2041. Requiem Signals are welcome everywhere and invited to nothing, because everyone knows what happens if you ask them who is on the tape.

Dying allies in range gain a +2 circumstance bonus to recovery checks, and you always know the instant one of them goes down, wherever they are in range.

7th — Hold the Line: spend 2 Encore to leave an ally at 1 Hit Point instead of 0. Once per ally per day.
15th — Encore Performance: spend your whole pool to return a creature dead for less than a minute to 1 HP. Once per day. What comes back sounds a little like the tape.

cinderfall.incomplete: Same base reasoning as `numbers-track`/`open-band-track` (SB4/SB3/P5) — though note per P13 the +2-to-recovery-check clause specifically *would* be a one-line `FlatModifier{selector:"recovery-check", type:"circumstance", value:2}` if it had a vehicle (a real, live selector), so this one is closer to buildable than its siblings once SB3/SB4 are resolved. "You always know the instant one of them goes down" (an omniscience/awareness grant, bucket 5, no selector) and the 7th/15th clauses (SB1: Encore cost; bucket 3: a full revivify-shaped ability grant) remain independently blocked.
